_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Guard the URL construction against a malformed `VITE_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_DASHBOARD_URL`.**

`new URL('/login', platformDashboardUrl)` throws a `TypeError` when `platformDashboardUrl` is not an absolute URL. The truthy check on Line 204 accepts values such as `dashboard.platform.example` or `/platform`. The throw happens during render, so the whole `Navbar` fails, not only the Platform link.

Also note that the absolute path `'/login'` discards any base path in the env value. `https://host.example/platform/` resolves to `https://host.example/login`.

<details>
<summary>🛡️ Proposed fix: resolve the login URL safely</summary>

```diff
-  const platformDashboardUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_DASHBOARD_URL;
+  const platformLoginUrl = useMemo(() => {
+    if (!import.meta.env.VITE_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_DASHBOARD_URL) {
+      return null;
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return new URL('login', import.meta.env.VITE_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_DASHBOARD_URL).href;
+    } catch {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }, []);
```

```diff
-          {platformDashboardUrl && (
+          {platformLoginUrl && (
             <a
               className="app-Navbar-platform-link"
-              href={new URL('/login', platformDashboardUrl).href}
+              href={platformLoginUrl}
```

`new URL('login', base)` keeps a base path when the base value ends with `/`. Use `'/login'` if you require a root-relative target.
</details>

